about_the_game:
This is additional content for Silent Tales‌: Vermilion Embers, and it does not include the standard edition of the game.

These pieces of music are all original creations, which were completed from around 2021 to 2025 and added to the game.

The instruments are all simulated by software, not real recordings, but still I believe that the emotions of some scenes in the game can be conveyed through these pieces of music.
